recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray (#f2f2f2).
2. Add the title text "Combine Precision and Recall in one number" at the top-left in large, bold, red (#c00000) sans-serif font.
3. Add a circle at the top-right containing the number "13" in white sans-serif text (circle fill color not specified in source).
4. Draw a large rectangle in the middle-left with a red (#c00000) border to frame the confusion matrix (fill color not specified).
5. Inside the matrix frame, place the header "Positive" in red (#c00000) text at the upper-left.
6. Place a simple line-drawing airplane icon above the Positive tree (icon color not specified).
7. Draw the Positive tree root as a red (#c00000) circle with white text "30".
8. Draw a blue (#0000ff) arrow from the Positive root down to the left child.
9. Draw the left child as a red (#c00000) circle with white text "20", and place the label "TP" in red (#c00000) text directly below the circle.
10. Draw a blue (#0000ff) arrow from the Positive root down to the right child.
11. Draw the right child as a green (#008000) circle with white text "10", and place the label "FN" in red (#c00000) text directly below the circle.
12. Inside the matrix frame, place the header "Negative" in green (#008000) text at the upper-right.
13. Place a simple line-drawing airplane icon above the Negative tree (icon color not specified).
14. Draw the Negative tree root as a green (#008000) circle with white text "70".
15. Draw a blue (#0000ff) arrow from the Negative root down to the left child.
16. Draw the left child as a green (#008000) circle with white text "59", and place the label "TN" in red (#c00000) text directly below the circle.
17. Draw a blue (#0000ff) arrow from the Negative root down to the right child.
18. Draw the right child as a red (#c00000) circle with white text "11", and place the label "FP" in red (#c00000) text directly below the circle.
19. In the middle-right upper position, add a yellow (#fff2cc) rounded rectangle with black (#000000) text "Precision = TP / (TP + FP)".
20. In the middle-right lower position, add a light-blue (#cfe2f3) rounded rectangle with a blue (#0000ff) border and black (#000000) text "Recall = TP / (TP + FN)".
21. In the bottom-left below the matrix, add a rectangle with a green (#008000) border and light-green (#e2efda) fill containing black (#000000) text on three lines: "Good Model:", "Properly Classifies 20 out of 30 as Positive", "Properly Classifies 59 out of 70 as Negative".
22. At the bottom, add the first stacked calculation box: a yellow (#fff2cc) rectangle with black (#000000) text "Precision= 20/(20+11) =64.5%".
23. Directly below the first box, add the second stacked calculation box: a light-blue (#cfe2f3) rectangle with black (#000000) text "Recall= 20/(20+10) =66.6%".
24. Directly below the second box, add the third stacked calculation box: a light-blue (#cfe2f3) rectangle with black (#000000) text "Average= 64.5%+66.6% =65.55%".
